conventions.prices: Undo vendor future split factors, including pseudo-splits for distributions, to reconstruct contemporaneous share units. Vendor rounding remains a precision limitation.
conventions.dividends: Vendor cash dividends, converted to contemporaneous share units, are credited on ex-date. No payment-date financing or tax model.
conventions.spinoffs: Parent share count stays unchanged. Fractional child shares are liquidated at their first regular-way open with the same proportional trading fee.
conventions.terminal: Cash consideration credited at effective open. Nontransferable contingent rights are recorded as units and valued at zero; no future contingent payment is assumed.
conventions.missing: Only reviewed terminal/prelisting absences are allowed. An unexplained missing quote aborts dataset preparation; it never becomes a zero return.
